default.notes: Apply for the eTA at the official portal etakenya.go.ke before departure (about 32–34 USD); approval is usually issued within 3 business days.

groups.notes: East African Community citizens are exempt from Kenya's eTA and can stay for up to 6 months; Kenya, Uganda and Rwanda also allow their citizens to travel on national ID cards.

Under Kenya's 2025 policy, citizens of nearly all African countries are exempt from the eTA for visits of up to about 60 days. The policy is recent and implementation details have shifted — confirm on etakenya.go.ke before travel.

KE.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Kenyan citizens.

SO.notes: Somalia is excluded from Kenya's African eTA exemption for security reasons — Somali citizens still need the eTA, and applications can undergo additional vetting; apply well in advance.

LY.notes: Libya is excluded from Kenya's African eTA exemption for security reasons — Libyan citizens still need the eTA, and applications can undergo additional vetting; apply well in advance.
